The app shows the carbon intensity of the electricity consumed in a zone, in grams of CO₂ equivalent per kilowatt-hour over the full life cycle (IPCC AR5 median values). Every 15 minutes the backend combines the generation per technology of all European countries with the physical cross-border flows and solves the whole grid at once (flow tracing, proportional sharing): imported electricity carries the intensity of the exporting zone. Pumped storage discharge counts with the intensity of its own zone. Data is published with a delay of typically 1–4 hours by the sources.
Green below %1$d, yellow %1$d–%2$d, red above %2$d gCO₂eq/kWh.
measured = actual values; forecast = partly forecasts; stale = last known value (max. 3 h) or older data; estimated = significant imports from zones without current data.
